name: Unified Data Processing Center of the Republic of Adygea
developer: Republic of Adygea / regional digital development bodies
notes: Regional official page lists operation of the unified data processing center among subordinate organization functions; GreenMDC press coverage says a Republic of Adygea data processing center was created for e-government systems. No IT load disclosed.

name: Government of the Altai Republic data-center modernization project
developer: Government of the Altai Republic / Galex
notes: Aggregator entries identify a Government of the Altai Republic data-center creation/modernization project by Galex; details and capacity not disclosed.

name: Altai Krai regional government data center, Barnaul
developer: Ministry of Digital Development and Communications of Altai Krai
notes: Regional government data center planned to start in December 2020 in the new digital ministry building at Karl Marx St. 1; equipment procurement budget was about 69 million rubles.

name: TTK Barnaul data center
notes: Local press described the Barnaul TTK data center as an autonomous protected facility connected to 80 optical channels of up to 100 Gbit/s each. No IT load disclosed.

name: Regional Data Processing Center, Blagoveshchensk
developer: Amur Oblast / Amurskaya Tsifrovaya Infrastruktura LLC
notes: Amur investment portal lists a 1.2 billion ruble PPP/concession regional data center, agreement signed in November 2024, six-year term, 675 sq m, two machine halls and fiber links to existing sites; PPPAdvisor names the site as Blagoveshchensk, Nagornaya St. 3.

name: Key Point Arkhangelsk Oblast Tier III data center
notes: Key Point and regional development bodies planned a Tier III data center in Arkhangelsk Oblast, with typical regional facility options from 100 to 1200 IT racks and expected investment of at least 300 million rubles; site selection/support still being developed.

name: Global Digital Group innovative data center, Astrakhan
notes: Governor Igor Babushkin said Global Digital Group plans an AI, machine-learning and cloud computing data center in Astrakhan with investments above 4.7 billion rubles and about 200 jobs. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Sintora data center, TOSER Blagoveshchensk
notes: RBC Ufa reported Sintora became a resident of the Blagoveshchensk priority development area and is building a data center with planned investment of 380 million rubles; launch planned Q4 2026, full capacity in 2027.

name: CentrInvest data center, TOSER Blagoveshchensk
notes: RBC Ufa noted CentrInvest was included as a Blagoveshchensk TOSER resident in October 2025 for a data center project estimated at 370 million rubles, planned for launch in H2 2026.

name: Blagenergo autonomous data center near Ufa
notes: UfaTime, citing the Republic Ministry of Economic Development, reported Blagenergo is implementing a 367 million ruble data center project with an autonomous gas-piston power plant; commissioning targeted Q4 2026 and full design capacity by 2028.

name: Belgorod Oblast government data center
developer: Government of Belgorod Oblast / Rostelecom facility support
notes: Belgorod Oblast opened a government data center in Belgorod for regional finance, document management, file storage and other public-sector systems; D-Russia reports a 220 million ruble regional budget cost and migration of services underway.

name: MegaFon modular data center, Bryansk Oblast
notes: MegaFon built the first scalable modular data center in Bryansk Oblast: over 400 sq m, more than 400 kW total power, about 60 ICT racks, up to 750 Gbit/s throughput, Tier III requirements; used for MegaFon telecom/server equipment and possible partner pilots.

name: Bryansk urban agglomeration ITS data processing center
developer: Government of Bryansk Oblast / transport and road safety program
notes: Official regional government page says the first stage of Bryansk intelligent transport systems created a traffic management center and data processing center, with continued 2023-2025 modernization of the data processing center and related subsystems.

name: BitRiver-B Mukhorshibir data center
notes: BitRiver project in Mukhorshibir, TOSER Buryatia, described as a 100 MW data center and largest in Russia's Far East; construction began in 2022, construction/installation work completed with grid connection still a barrier, and company says it is being repurposed from mining toward AI.

name: Freecom commercial data center, Ulan-Ude
notes: Freecom's official site advertises a commercial Ulan-Ude data center for colocation, rack and rack-unit rental, up to 5 kW per 42U rack and up to 10 kW guaranteed power per rack; no aggregate IT load disclosed.
